Subject: Intro — Passageway x Redwood resell/referral idea

Hey Camila,

Great speaking at the summit — Passageway is interested in a lightweight resale + referral arrangement so we can embed Redwood inference as an option in our admin console and co-sell to our mid-market customers. Two quick asks from our side:

1) A clear commission table for leads we refer vs. customers we resell (we'll own the first invoice).
2) A simple lead-registration and protection window so our sales team has confidence when we bring deals in.

Can you share what a standard commercial framework looks like and any operational steps (portal, MOP) we should expect?

Cc'ing Katie (our Head of Partnerships) and procurement. Thanks — Tom

--
Tom Alvarez
VP Business Development | Passageway
From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Tom Alvarez <tom@passageway.com>
Cc: Katie Lin <katie@passageway.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intro — Passageway x Redwood resell/referral idea

Tom — great to connect. Appreciated the Summit chat.

High level we typically offer two parallel tracks for partners like Passageway:

- Referral: fixed one-time referral fee (percentage of first-year ARR) for a registered lead that converts.
- Resale (co-managed): partner invoices the customer; Redwood invoices partner monthly/quarterly for hosted usage and shares a revenue-split on recurring payments.

Operational items we'll include in the draft MOP: lead registration portal link, 90/120-day protection windows (can be negotiated), clawback provisions for chargebacks/cancellations, onboarding milestones (tech integration + SOC checklist), and a short co-marketing credit for the first 6 months.

I'm looping Ben to run the commercial math and Marissa to flag any channel program constraints. I will put together a first-pass MOP and commission matrix for you by next Tuesday.

Would you prefer a referral-first model with an option to move to resale after 6 months, or a straight resale approach from day one? That will change the sample numbers.

Best,
Camila
Director, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Passageway — commercial sketch

Camila / Marissa — quick internal note with proposed starter terms for negotiation (numbers are illustrative):

- Referral: 10% of first-year ARR, paid within 45 days of customer payment. Lead registration window: 120 days from registration. Clawback period: 12 months prorated.
- Resale (partner invoices): gross margin split = 18% to partner on net revenues for first 12 months, 12% thereafter. Onboarding fee credit: Redwood waives first-month platform fees for customers onboarded through Passageway during pilot.
- Lead protection: 120-day exclusive registration, with an extension to 180 days if Passageway provides SOW/active outreach log in the portal.
- Marketplace listing fee: waived for 6 months; co-marketing credit of $5k for joint webinars/PR.

Operational: we will require (1) partner onboarding checklist (SOC questionnaire completed), (2) access to test tenant, and (3) signed MSA + SOW. Portal registration will be via partners.redwood.ai and logged against PWY-5638.

Marissa — anything from channel policy we need to restrict (e.g., special exceptions, exclusive territories)?

Ben
Sr. Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Katie Lin <katie@passageway.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@passageway.com>, procurement@passageway.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intro — Passageway x Redwood resell/referral idea

Thanks Ben and Camila — those numbers are helpful. A couple of asks from Passageway procurement and sales ops before we take this to legal: 

1) Can we get the registration window to be 180 days on referrals by default? Our sales cycle averages 4-5 months and we don't want to lose protection if procurement stretches.
2) For resale splits, can we add a 6-month pilot discount for customers under $75k ARR (we'd like a 25% discount to accelerate trials), with the stated revenue split calculated on net after discount?
3) Can you confirm clawback calculation — is it prorated monthly over 12 months from invoice date?

We'll share a redline on the MOP once we have the draft. Also please add any UX notes about how leads appear in the partner portal (metadata we should capture: lead owner, ARR estimate, lead creation date, source).

—Katie
Head of Partnerships | Passageway
From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Tom Alvarez <tom@passageway.com>, Katie Lin <katie@passageway.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 16:37:00 -0700
Subject: Passageway MOP v1 + mutual action plan

Team — attaching the first-pass MOP + commission matrix (attached). Key changes from Ben's sketch reflected per Katie's ask:

- Lead registration window: default 120 days; Passageway option to elect 180 days per lead at time of registration (must include outreach log or active opportunity entry).
- Pilot discount: allowed for customers <$75k ARR at 25% off list for the first 6 months; revenue split computed on net invoice post-discount.
- Clawback: prorated monthly over 12 months from payment date; if customer churns pre-12 months, Passageway will remit partner-paid portion for remaining months on a prorated basis.
- Payment terms: Redwood pays referral fees within 45 days of receiving customer payment; resale settlement to partner on net monthly invoices, with a monthly remittance statement.

Mutual action plan (high level):
1) 08/09 — sign MOU (commercial term sheet) and enable partner portal access.
2) 08/23 — Passageway completes SOC questionnaire + test tenant access.
3) 09/06 — joint technical onboarding call and first pilot customer enabled.
4) 10/01 — marketplace listing live + joint webinar scheduled.

Please review the attached MOP and commission matrix. If Passageway agrees to the mutual action plan above, we'll convert the MOU to an MSA + SOW template for legal redlines.

Attachments: passageway-redwood-mop-v1.pdf, pw-redwood-commission-matrix.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Camila
Director, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
